fusions.name: Shaken Droplets
fusions.desc: Shakes the drawn poison off your feathers, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking them back 2 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn Bead
fusions.desc: Flicks a bead of water that deals 8 damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and draws it out, using it up, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Bitter Runoff
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to run off and land on whoever laid it instead, for 8 seconds. You take 10% less poison damage.

fusions.name: Oiled Against Venom
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 6%, you take 15% less poison damage, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
